gh_bare="$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-gh.git"
repo="$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-widgets"
rm -rf "$gh_bare" "$repo"
git init -q --bare "$gh_bare"

git init -q "$repo"
git -C "$repo" config user.name "Loom AFT"
git -C "$repo" config user.email "aft@example.test"
# A small, obviously-wrong slice so the model has something concrete to find.
# The assertion never depends on the model's wording — only on it naming this file.
printf 'package widget\n\nfunc ParseName(s string) string {\n\treturn s\n}\n' > "$repo/widget.go"
git -C "$repo" add widget.go
git -C "$repo" commit -qm "add widget parser"
git -C "$repo" branch -M main
git -C "$repo" remote add origin "https://github.com/acme/widgets"
git -C "$repo" push -q "$gh_bare" main
base_sha="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"

git -C "$repo" checkout -qb feature/auth
printf 'package widget\n\nfunc ParseName(s string) string {\n\treturn s[1:]\n}\n' > "$repo/widget.go"
git -C "$repo" commit -qam "trim leading character"
head_sha="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
git -C "$repo" push -q "$gh_bare" feature/auth
git -C "$repo" checkout -q main
# This is what makes the PR fetchable without GitHub.
git -C "$gh_bare" update-ref "refs/pull/7/head" "$head_sha"

# Register while origin still says github.com (RemoteURL is captured here, once).
python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"name":sys.argv[1],"type":"empty","repos":[sys.argv[2]]}))' \
  "e2e-ws-prlive" "$repo" > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-workspace.json"
curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_BASE_URL/api/workspaces" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @"$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-workspace.json" > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-workspace.resp.json"
python3 - "$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-workspace.resp.json" "$AFT_WORK_DIR" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("data") or {}
work = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
work.joinpath("prlive-workspace.path").write_text(data["path"], encoding="utf-8")
repos = data.get("repos") or []
assert repos, data
work.joinpath("prlive-repo.name").write_text(repos[0]["name"], encoding="utf-8")
PY

# Repoint AFTER registration so the fetch resolves locally while the stored
# RemoteURL keeps saying github.com.
git -C "$repo" remote set-url origin "file://$gh_bare"

# S2: install the fixture credential. Without it ensureConnectorAndGrants fails
# before any HTTP call (seed.go:36-49) and every case here 503s.
curl -sf -X PATCH "$AFT_BASE_URL/api/local/settings" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"runtime_credentials":{"github":{"token":"aft-fixture-token"}}}' >/dev/null

# Point the fixture at the SHAs git actually produced. EnsureDetachedGitWorktreeAtPRHead
# compares the fetched tip against the connector's head.sha and returns
# PRHeadChangedError on mismatch (localworkspace.go:238-241), so the fixture's default
# placeholder sha would fail every run with a misleading "stale_subject".
python3 - "$head_sha" "$base_sha" > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-fixture.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
head, base = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
print(json.dumps({
    "pr": {
        "number": 7, "state": "open", "title": "Trim leading character",
        "draft": False, "merged_at": None, "user": {"login": "octocat"},
        "updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "head": {"sha": head, "ref": "feature/auth"},
        "base": {"sha": base, "ref": "main"},
    },
    "files": [{
        "filename": "widget.go", "status": "modified",
        "additions": 1, "deletions": 1,
        "patch": "@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@\n package widget\n \n func ParseName(s string) string {\n-\treturn s\n+\treturn s[1:]\n }",
    }],
}))
PY
curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_FAKE_GH_BASE/__fixture" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @"$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-fixture.json" >/dev/null
# Reset the request log AFTER seeding so the read-only assertion only sees
# requests the reviewer itself made.
curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_FAKE_GH_BASE/__reset" >/dev/null
curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_FAKE_GH_BASE/__fixture" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @"$AFT_WORK_DIR/prlive-fixture.json" >/dev/null

  dict(json.loads(sys.argv[2]), next="tool"), dict(json.loads(sys.argv[3]), next="prompt")]}))' "$1" "$2" "$3" |
  curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_FAKE_MODEL_URL/__script" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @- >/dev/null

# ui-turn <agent id> <turn JSON>: the agent's next turn. A turn with tools
# or reasoning is, on the emulator, the agent's one scenario turn (the
# emulator runs no tools and the fake model sends no reasoning); any other
# turn's text comes from the fake model, which records the request.
cat > "$AFT_WORK_DIR/ui-turn" <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
curl -sf -X POST "$AFT_FAKE_MODEL_URL/__reset" >/dev/null
python3 - "$1" "$2" "${AFT_EMU_SCENARIOS:-}" "$AFT_FAKE_MODEL_URL" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys, urllib.request
agent, turn, scenarios, model = sys.argv[1], json.loads(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
if scenarios and (turn.get("tools") or turn.get("reasoning")):
    cur = json.load(open(scenarios)) if os.path.exists(scenarios) and os.path.getsize(scenarios) else {}
    cur[agent] = [turn]
    json.dump(cur, open(scenarios, "w"))
else:
    steps = []
    if turn.get("tools"):
        steps.append({"tool_calls": [{"name": t["name"], "arguments": t["input"]} for t in turn["tools"]]})
    steps.append({"text": turn["text"]})
    req = urllib.request.Request(model + "/__script", data=json.dumps({"steps": steps}).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    urllib.request.urlopen(req).read()
PY
SH
chmod +x "$AFT_WORK_DIR/ui-turn"
